lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense, semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots following the longitudinal axis of the body, extending from the post-branchial region towards the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical columns of high-intensity blobs that align with the longitudinal carinae to form a coarse grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the lateral and dorsal surfaces, characterized by a high-intensity light edge above a lower-intensity shadowed trough.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of low-resolution high-luminance blobs against a darker ground, though clarity is limited by distance and water turbidity.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a striped remora attached to the ventral surface, showing distinct horizontal banding of alternating high and low pixel intensity.
